examples.en: According to Klawans, ritual purification involved separation from those aspects of humanity, death and sex, which are least God-like.
examples.zh: 根据克洛文的理解，仪式的净化包括从人性、死亡和性的那些方面分离出来，这些方面与上帝最不相似。

examples.en: In the future, more effective washing techniques, management procedures, and recycling and purification of water will be needed to reduce wastage.
examples.zh: 在未来，将需要更有效的清洗技术、管理程序以及水的回收和净化技术，以减少浪费。

examples.en: One of the most advantageous and widely used method is the tandem affinity purification.
examples.zh: 串联亲和纯化是目前应用最广泛、最具优势的方法之一。
